questions.q: Why was wine given the name karam in jahiliyyah?
options: Because it was linked to generosity
questions.explain: The forbidden is often given a good-sounding name.

options: Carrion, an animal that died without slaughter
questions.explain: Ja'far said his people ate carrion. The ustaz advises us to watch what we eat.

questions.q: Who explained the state of jahiliyyah to Najashi?
questions.explain: Ja'far summarised his people's jahiliyyah before Najashi.

questions.q: Where was Zaid bin Harithah sold as a child?
questions.explain: Zaid was captured by raiders and sold for 400 dirhams.

questions.q: Who gave Zaid to the Prophet SAW as a gift?
questions.explain: Khadijah gave Zaid at the time of the marriage.

questions.q: Why did Zaid choose to stay with the Prophet SAW even though his father came?
options: Because of a love he had never known before

questions.q: What did Al-Ahzab 33:5 change about adopted children?
options: They are attributed to the guardians
They are attributed to their biological fathers, not the guardians
questions.explain: Zaid went back to being known as Zaid bin Harithah.

questions.q: If a person's character is still lacking, we should review his creed and worship.
questions.explain: True. Character is the output of Islam.

questions.q: Najashi passed judgement at once without hearing the defence.
questions.explain: False. Najashi heard the accusation and the defence first.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.

items.text: Zaid is given to the Prophet SAW
Zaid is declared a son at the Kaaba
Zaid's father meets the Prophet SAW

questions.explain: Zaid was kidnapped, gifted, his father came, Zaid chose to stay, then he was declared a son at the Kaaba.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.
questions.explain: Jahiliyyah is ignorance, asnam are idols, silaturahim is family ties and maysir is gambling.
